description: Press the platform kill switch: pause every model call and suspend every personal access token minted or used in the last N hours (KILL_SWITCH_WINDOW_HOURS, default 24), platform-wide. Git, CI, merges and deploys are unaffected. One forensic audit row (security.kill_switch) names every suspended token and its previous expiry; every site admin is alerted. Site admins with an admin-scoped token only. Not idempotent: a second press suspends whatever the window holds then. Mirrors POST /api/v2/admin/security/kill-switch. Returns {at, windowHours, suspended, aiWasPaused, auditId, effect}.
name: gluecron_press_kill_switch
